football_evidence.question: Can Missouri State contain Delaware’s explosive runs?
football_evidence.assessment: No material disagreement: EdgeDesk and the line are within 1.8 points.
supporting: When Delaware has the ball (big plays through the air): Delaware’s offense turns 13.8% of its pass plays into explosive gains, and Missouri State’s defense gives up explosive gains on 11.6% of opponent pass plays (FBS average 10.3%).

When Missouri State has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Missouri State’s offense has allowed a sack on 5.8% of its dropbacks, and Delaware’s defense sacks the quarterback on 8.6% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Missouri State has the ball (the red zone): Missouri State’s offense succeeds on 29.7% of its red-zone plays, and Delaware’s defense allows success on 43.9% of opponent red-zone plays (FBS average 43.6%).
In his last two games (SMU and Western Kentucky), Locklear averaged 4.4 yards per attempt, against 9.2 in his three games before that.
contradicting: When Delaware has the ball (pass protection against the pass rush): Delaware’s offense has allowed a sack on 8.4% of its dropbacks, and Missouri State’s defense sacks the quarterback on 3.1% of opponent dropbacks (FBS average 5.6%).

When Delaware has the ball (big plays on the ground): Delaware’s offense turns 1.9% of its runs into explosive gains, and Missouri State’s defense gives up explosive gains on 5.5% of opponent runs (FBS average 6.6%).
EdgeDesk’s position-group ratings put Missouri State’s offense No. 88 nationally and Delaware’s No. 126.
When Delaware has the ball (the run game against the run defense): Delaware’s offense averages 4.3 yards per carry, and Missouri State’s defense allows 4.8 yards per carry (FBS average 5.1).
quarterbacks: Nick Minicucci has completed 59 of 102 passes (57.8%) for 889 yards, 8.7 yards per attempt, 6 touchdowns and 3 interceptions in four games for Delaware, and has been sacked on 8 of 110 dropbacks.
Tyler Bell has completed 26 of 45 passes (57.8%) for 348 yards, 7.7 yards per attempt, 3 touchdowns and 1 interception in two games for Delaware, and has been sacked on 7 of 52 dropbacks.

Skyler Locklear has completed 71 of 108 passes (65.7%) for 788 yards, 7.3 yards per attempt, 4 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in five games for Missouri State, and has been sacked on 9 of 117 dropbacks.
Henry Belin IV has completed 47 of 73 passes (64.4%) for 550 yards, 7.5 yards per attempt, 4 touchdowns and 2 interceptions in five games for Missouri State, and has been sacked on 3 of 76 dropbacks.
